# axual_user (List Resource)

Lists users in the tenant. Users cannot be created with Terraform, so a generated `axual_user` can only manage a user that already exists.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Only users whose email address contains this text (case-insensitive).
- `role` (String) Only users with this role, for example `TENANT_ADMIN`.
